visual_action: A fast-paced montage of celebratory scenes from various popular movies and TV shows. Characters are shown shouting, cheering, dancing, and expressing relief and joy. The video concludes with black and white shots of the White House exterior, a helicopter, and the flag.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The post caption states: 'BREAKING: Trump just signed the deal that SAVES TIKTOK.'

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video ends with shots of the building and on-screen text that reads 'THE WHITE HOUSE'. The post is also from the official @whitehouse account.

spoken_summary: A cacophony of celebratory dialogue from various movies and TV shows, layered over each other. Key lines include a character singing "I'm ready to party," and others yelling "The show goes on! We are back, baby!", "We're back!", "Let's go!", "We're going to survive!", and "We did it!"
audio_music: The video begins with diegetic audio of a character singing "I'm ready to party" from the movie Bridesmaids. After about 8 seconds, a high-energy, celebratory electronic/hip-hop track kicks in and plays for the remainder of the video, accompanying the montage of enthusiastic dialogue from different film clips. The overall effect is one of hype and victory.
editing_pacing: Very fast-paced montage with rapid cuts between dozens of short clips.
